name: Maine
nameStory: The likeliest explanation is the simplest: sailors working a coast studded with more than 4,000 islands needed a word for the solid part, so they called it the main land. Maine is the mainland, as opposed to everything else out there.
capitalStory: Augusta sits at the head of navigation on the Kennebec River - the exact point where ocean-going ships had to stop and cargo moved onto land. Towns almost always grow where travel changes mode, and capitals often follow.

majorFeatures.name: Mount Katahdin
majorFeatures.note: Northern end of the Appalachian Trail

majorFeatures.name: Gulf of Maine
majorFeatures.note: Cold, rich fishing and lobster grounds

funFacts: Maine borders exactly one other state, fewer than any other state in the country.
It is the only state with a one-syllable name.
About 90% of Maine is forested - the most heavily wooded state in the nation.
West Quoddy Head is the easternmost point in the US, so the sun rises on America there first.
whyItMatters: Maine only became a state as one half of the Missouri Compromise of 1820: it entered free so Missouri could enter as a slave state and keep the Senate balanced. Maine's statehood was a bargaining chip over slavery.
